links.outcome: Positive predictive value of LLM detection of pulmonary embolism adverse event at 0.4% prevalence
links.effect: High sensitivity (87.5-100%) and specificity (94.9-98.9%) but low PPV; best F1 was 28.11%, so LLMs cannot be relied on solely for definitive identification.
links.quote: While these models serve as effective screening tools to exclude non-PEAE cases, their lower PPV indicates they cannot be relied upon solely for definitive PEAE identification.

unlisted_practices: Keyword-based versus semantic similarity retrieval filtering for LLM chart review
Including discharge summary sections to improve LLM adverse event detection

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM pipeline for retrospective surveillance of pulmonary embolism adverse events from EMR notes, evaluating algorithmic performance without testing an organizational deployment practice.
